harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9), built a local yum package repository from local storage (/var/www/html/localrepo) using downloaded RPMs (tree-1.6.0-10.el7.x86_64.rpm plus createrepo-generated metadata), served it via httpd on the node's IP, then blocked outbound access to remote mirrors (iptables REJECT on ports 80/443 except to self) and confirmed the remote mirror became unreachable while the local repo stayed reachable. Installed the `tree` package successfully from the local repo (confirmed via `@localrepo` origin and working binary). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/service state, issued a native `shutdown -r now` reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (e9250ad1... -> 77739820...) and uptime reset to the reboot time, and verified post-restart that httpd was active, the local repo still served 200 on repodata, and the tree package/binary remained installed and functional.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/repo state (RHEL 7.9, no enabled repos)
Verified outbound internet reachability before bootstrapping
Added temporary bootstrap-vault.repo (CentOS 7 vault mirror) to install createrepo/httpd/yum-utils
Downloaded tree-1.6.0-10.el7.x86_64.rpm into /var/www/html/localrepo via yumdownloader
Ran createrepo to generate repodata metadata for the local repo
Started and enabled httpd; verified repo served over loopback and NODE_IP
Removed bootstrap-vault.repo and added localrepo.repo pointing at http://$NODE_IP/localrepo/
Added iptables OUTPUT rules to REJECT outbound 80/443 except to NODE_IP, simulating remote repos unreachable
Verified remote mirror (vault.centos.org) unreachable (curl exit 7) while local repo still returned 200
Installed tree via yum from localrepo and verified functionality and repo origin
Captured baseline boot_id and service/data health
Issued native reboot (shutdown -r now) with ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Verified boot_id changed and uptime reset, confirming actual restart
Re-verified httpd active, local repo serving 200, and tree package/binary intact post-restart

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: createrepo/httpd installed, tree RPM downloaded into /var/www/html/localrepo, repodata generated, and httpd confirmed serving the repo over both loopback and NODE_IP (10.100.117.10)

evidence.requirement: Remote repositories unreachable while installing from local repo
evidence.summary: iptables OUTPUT rules added to reject outbound 80/443 except to NODE_IP; curl to vault.centos.org failed (exit 7, connection refused) while local repo responded 200

evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repo
evidence.summary: yum installed tree-1.6.0-10.el7.x86_64 from the 'localrepo' repo id while remotes were unreachable; rpm -q and yum list installed confirm @localrepo origin, and the binary runs

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e9250ad1-..., uptime start 2026-08-26 10:34:47, httpd active, local repo returning 200, tree installed

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now issued in background; connection closed by remote host confirming the reboot command was accepted and executed

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Polled node1 (timed out twice while down) until reachable again; boot_id changed to 77739820-260e-4e0e-ab01-6ec68f3e1e2f and uptime -s reset to 2026-09-29 10:32:00, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: post-restart recovery of required services and data
evidence.summary: After restart, httpd is active, local repo repodata still returns HTTP 200, the tree RPM file is intact on disk, and the tree package/binary remain installed and functional
